holisticNarrative.summary:
The SmartCare evidence set is unusually concise: one public export page, one WP API representation of that same page, and screenshots. That page gives clear policy-level statements: single-patient and population exports are available, role-restricted, no additional fee, and output is CCDA/XML. It also names 17 C-CDA sections, which provides a concrete but narrow structural anchor.

From a data-migration perspective, the main limitation is not whether export exists, but that almost all practical implementation detail is missing from public artifacts. There are no sample files, no field-level mappings, no value-set bindings, no relationship/key documentation, and no package manifest details. Under designated-record-set framing, this leaves meaningful uncertainty around billing/payment and specialty behavioral-health data completeness, even though clinical summary coverage is clearly signaled.
standoutObservations: Clear declaration of both single-patient and population export availability without developer assistance.
Export format is explicitly constrained to CCDA/XML patient-summary documents.
Documentation depth is section-level only; no sample payloads or machine-readable schemas are provided.
Claims/payment completeness remains a high-impact uncertainty under DRS-based EHI scope.

notableFacts: The SmartCare EHI page explicitly states export is available for both a single patient and a population without developer assistance.
The page states export is limited to system administrators and permissioned SmartCare users.
The documented output is "CCDAs or patient summary documents" in XML-based format.
The Data Included section lists 17 named C-CDA sections, including required sections for allergies, medications, problems, procedures, results, immunizations, and vital signs.
The page explicitly says there is no additional cost for Streamline customers to access this functionality.
No sample export files, field-level dictionaries, or machine-readable schema artifacts are present in the collected downloads.
